The '''Economic Study Circle''', also known as the '''Economic WatchCircle'''<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide1" /> and the '''economic circle''',<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 33">[[Knights of the Old Republic 33|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 33]]</ref> was a [[Covenant WatchCircle|WatchCircle]] of the [[Jedi Covenant]], being among those devoted to providing early warnings regarding galactic life.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide1" /> In particular, the Economic WatchCircle was established in order to provide early warnings after sensing changes in various economic aspects of galactic life.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 18">[[Knights of the Old Republic 18|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 18]]</ref>

Several years prior to the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the Economic WatchCircle had foreseen that [[Vanjervalis Systems]] were working on a [[Vanjervalis Chain|breakthrough naval system]]. After [[Haazen]] had obtained designs<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 33" /> revealing that the breakthrough system would allow [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|Republic cruisers]] to be linked to a [[Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship|single command]],<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 34">[[Knights of the Old Republic 34|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 34]]</ref> he reported the Economic WatchCircle's prediction to [[Krynda Draay]], claiming that he would have the [[Draay Trust]] buy out Vanjervalis in order to increase funding for the Covenant's activities.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 33" /> In actuality, he slipped in an extra feature past the [[Admiralty (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Admiralty]] in order to have a direct line to himself for his planned [[Vindication]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 34" />

Under the recommendation of the Economic WatchCircle, Haazen had the Draay Trust sell off all of their holdings on the banking world of [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] at some unspecified time before the [[Battle of Serroco]]. By the time Telerath became a potential [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] target, the Draay Trust's holdings there had already been completely sold. [[Lucien Draay]] was apparently unaware that Haazen was taking the investment advice of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Seers of the Circle|Seers]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 18" />

Later, it was unknown what became of the Economic WatchCircle during and in the aftermath of Haazen's disastrous Vindication.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 34" />
